panels.rationale: Single clinical photo of both hands in a Carpenter Syndrome case report with caption 'Hands with brachydactyly' and in-text 'brachydactyly (Figure 1)', showing short broad hands consistent with brachydactyly of the hands.
panels.attribution_text: Kashiv et al. A Rare Case of Carpenter Syndrome and Its Unique Association With Chronic Kidney Disease.. Cureus 2024. doi:10.7759/cureus.62823. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
in_text_mentions: Further examination revealed atrophic left kidney and right kidney showing raised echotexture with loss of corticomedullary differentiation, as well as additional findings of truncal obesity, brachydactyly (Figure 1), hypothyroidism, and craniofacial abnormalities.
panels.copyright: Kashiv et al. A Rare Case of Carpenter Syndrome and Its Unique Association With Chronic Kidney Disease.. Cureus 2024. doi:10.7759/cureus.62823. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
